important_book_quotes_paraphrased: The Potatoverse can be thought of as a cosmic potato field where beings/worlds are ripples in the Potato Archetype.
Everything-is-potato is compared to the unified-field idea that forces and particles are expressions of one underlying field.
Chapter 82 frames hidden dimensions and string/M-theory as routes toward force unification.
Chapter 90 aims to connect quantum mysteries, particles, forces and universal unity through Potatoverse metaphors.
Chapter 91 describes dark matter/dark energy as complementary soil/growth imagery.
boundaries: Book statements about entanglement do not establish universal instantaneous causal influence between all objects.
Book support percentages and some neuroscience/field values are not scientific-consensus metrics without source audit.
Dark matter/dark energy Soil language is metaphorical and does not solve either physical problem.
The presence of QFT/string terminology in the Great Book establishes project genealogy, not empirical validation.
Later WKB, CHSH, QFT microcausality, CY Hodge/SYZ and G2 equations are archive developments unless primary earlier text is recovered.
